predictions.selection_reason: externally controlled jsModuleId -> passed to require() in dynamically constructed JavaScript -> potential arbitrary code execution
predictions.source_summary: jsModuleId comes from flashvars.jsModuleId parameter, which is loaded from LoaderInfo(this.root.loaderInfo).parameters (SWF parameters/FlashVars)
predictions.sink_summary: Calls JavaScript function that dynamically constructs and executes: require(jsModuleId) to load a module, then calls ZeroClipboard.dispatch
predictions.guard_summary: Only basic backslash escaping is applied to jsModuleId. No validation of module identifier format or allowlisting of permitted modules.
predictions.risk_pattern: Attacker-controlled jsModuleId parameter is passed directly to require() in dynamically constructed JavaScript code, enabling arbitrary module loading and code execution
predictions.context_summary: The jsModuleId is used to construct JavaScript code that calls require() with user input, bypassing normal module loading security
unresolved_facts: Specific security controls in the JavaScript module loader environment
Whether the JavaScript environment restricts require() calls
Impact of arbitrary module loading in the target environment
